question: Which of the following drug causes Pseudotumour cerebri -
analysis: Pseudotumor cerebri, also known as idiopathic intracranial hypertension, is a condition characterized by increased intracranial pressure without a detectable cause. Among the listed drugs, Tetracycline is known to be associated with the development of pseudotumor cerebri. This condition has been documented in medical literature as a side effect of tetracycline, particularly when used in higher doses or for prolonged periods.
